string.text: Submachine gun, developed in the early 1990s at the request of Ministry of Internal Affairs of Russia. The internal mechanism, as it happens with many guns made by Izhevsk Machine-Building Plant, at its core is similar to a standard AK-74 mechanism, thus most parts are interchangeable. In the process of downscaling the rifle to a pistol caliber the method of operation was changed to straight blow-back. Equipped with a compact helical-feed magazine and a dovetail mount.
